newsitem.title: INDIA: India TISL changes name to Tata IBM.
newsitem.headline: India TISL changes name to Tata IBM.

text.p: India's Tata Information Systems Ltd. said on Wednesday it was changing its name to Tata IBM Ltd with immediate effect in order to emphasise its relationship with US computer giant International Business Machines Corp (IBM).

"There ia s clear need for the company to project itself in the market as an IBM and Tata company and leverage this relationship," the firm said in a statement. "With this objective the company is being renamed as Tata IBM Ltd."
There will be no change in the firm's equity holding pattern, the statement said. The firm continues to be a 50:50 joint venture between IBM and the Tatas, India's largest business house.
